cases.detail: CareerAccess.healthPlan (120) with the career Google grant reported expired: tasks needing gmail/calendar pause, a task needing nothing external keeps running, and exactly ONE re-auth message is produced for the dead grant (gmail+calendar share it — the BUG-005 grouping).
cases.name: session death mid-run
cases.spec_text: The session dies mid-run → only dependent tasks pause, one re-auth message is sent, and everything else continues.

cases.detail: 141 fillDoorstep on workday-like.json (sink behavior accept-but-timeout) → submitDoorstep reports unknown_outcome with exactly 1 sink receipt; three further approve-and-submit attempts are all duplicate-refused (retries stay 0, receipts stay 1); 'did it go through?' reconciles from the sink before any retry.
cases.name: send timeout → unconfirmed, no blind retry past cap
cases.spec_text: The provider times out on send → the item is marked unconfirmed, never retried blindly past the daily cap.

cases.detail: The GT-07 fixture event (evt_TEST_9f42, application.status_changed) is delivered to 141 applyQueueEvent twice, byte-identical: first applies once, second is deduped; the simulated log holds exactly 1 row and the item status changes exactly once.
cases.name: duplicate webhook → idempotent
cases.spec_text: Duplicate webhook delivery → idempotent: no double sends, no double log rows.

cases.detail: 132 enforceDailyCap with a log that fills the cap on 2026-10-13 (America/Chicago). The harness resolves the local date from the instant via Intl in America/Chicago: at 2026-10-14T04:30Z (23:30 CDT Oct 13) allowed=0; at 2026-10-14T05:30Z (00:30 CDT Oct 14) the full cap is available again. NOTE: the tz conversion lives in this harness sim (Intl), and 132 keys the cap by the supplied local date string — the sim proves the composition, and flags that no product code path of its own performs this conversion in the chat path.
cases.name: midnight cap reset in the user's timezone
cases.spec_text: The clock crosses midnight in the user's timezone during a wave → the daily cap resets correctly.
